title: Swarmscope world
description: One simulated place, its people and the question to answer. See worlds/SCHEMA.md for guidance. Fields listed as required are what a complete world should contain; the engine fills defaults for anything missing and reports each fix as a warning.

question.description: The decision the run informs, phrased as a ranking question (which, where, which fix).

context.description: One or two sentences every agent is told about the setting: day, time, place, what people are doing. Defaults to the title.

leaveLabel.description: Visit mode: label of the leave option, e.g. 'Give up and eat somewhere else'.

mode.description: visit: people choose among places that each have a line and servers. route: people travel from an origin to a destination through a network of capacity-limited links (roads, or corridors, doors, turnstiles and elevators in a building).

duration.description: Simulated minutes. Default 600 (visit) or 180 (route). Leave time after arrivals.end for people to finish.

clockStart.description: Wall-clock time at minute 0, in minutes after midnight (690 = 11:30 am).

travelSpeed.description: Visit mode: map units per minute (alias walkSpeed). The map is 100 x 100 units; walking time = distance / travelSpeed + 0.5 min. A floor plan at about 0.5 m per unit walks at about 135 (75 m/min / geo.metersPerUnit). Values above 600 are clamped with a warning.

nodes.description: Visit: gate/entry/exit/service places. Route: origin/destination/intersection points.

edges.description: Route mode only (required there): links between nodes.

archetypes.description: 2-4 behavioral groups with shares of arrivals.

minds.description: The cast: write 10-20 concrete invented people with situations, constraints, loyalties, who they listen to, and app or no app. Every archetype needs at least one persona, or it gets no agents.

walls.description: Optional floor-plan walls nobody can walk through, in map units (0-100, the same space as nodes). A doorway is a gap: give the wall as the pieces on either side. Touching a wall counts as crossing it. More than 4000 is an error; with walls, every node must be at least 0.05 from every wall, route edges may not touch a wall, and every visit service must be reachable on foot from a gate or entry and reach a gate or exit.

geo.description: Optional scale and path clearance of a floor plan.

metersPerUnit.description: Real size of one map unit. Informational: set travelSpeed to walking speed (about 75-80 m/min) / metersPerUnit; the engine accepts up to 600.

clearance.description: Map units walking paths keep from wall ends. At most a quarter of the narrowest door.

floor.description: Which floor the plan shows: a number or a label.

source.description: Where the plan came from, e.g. matterport-vector.

doors.description: Optional doorway gap segments. Doors are not walls; in visit mode every walking path that crosses one counts a crossing there. A door should sit exactly in a gap between walls.

provenance.description: Optional: where each value came from, keyed by field path (e.g. 'nodes[3].servers', 'walls', 'arrivals.total'). Kept as-is.

offers.description: Optional targeted offers: a message, and optionally a discount at one service place, for some kinds of people during a window. A person in the audience sees up to 3 offer texts in what they decide from, and pays the discounted price at that place (in what they are shown, in the rules policy and in what they spend). An offer informs; it never forces anyone anywhere. Results: metrics().offers gives, per offer, how many people it reached and how many of them then went to its place; each visit agent's spent and visits, and metrics().segments, show outcomes by kind of simulated person. A what-if patch can add one with { "kind": "offer", "offer": { ... } }.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, at most 40 characters. Other characters are replaced with underscores.

total.description: Number of agents over the whole run. Drives cost.

start.description: Minutes after clockStart of the first arrival; at most duration - 1.

end.description: Minutes after clockStart of the last arrival; between start + 1 and duration. Default 0.6 x duration.

shape.description: uniform: flat. peak: busiest halfway between start and end. early: front-loaded. late: back-loaded. poisson: constant-rate random gaps.

name.description: Shown to agents and in reports.

kind.description: Visit mode: gate (entrance and exit), entry, exit, service (a place with a line; at least one required). Route mode: origin, destination, intersection (any junction, lobby, landing or turnstile line).

x.description: Map position, x to the right.

weight.description: Visit gate/entry: relative share of arrivals entering here.

servers.description: Visit service: people served at the same time (desks, beds, cooks, seats).

serviceTime.description: Visit service: average minutes per person per server. Capacity per hour = servers / serviceTime x 60.

serviceDist.description: Visit service: spread of service times. uniform 0.6-1.4 x serviceTime, exponential with mean serviceTime, or fixed.

appeal.description: Visit service: popularity and reputation as a number, used by the rules policy. Keep it consistent with about.

price.description: Visit service: dollars per person. Agents see 'free' or 'about $N'. What each person pays (after any offer) adds up in their spent.

tags.description: Visit service: what the place offers. Matched against archetype needs (hard filter) and likes (soft preference).

about.description: Visit service: the reputation agents read, in plain words (known for, rumors, quirks).

from.description: Node id where the link starts.

to.description: Node id where the link ends. Avoid two edges with the same from and to; add an intermediate node instead.

name.description: Shown to agents (route labels) and in reports.

length.description: Free-flow travel time in minutes. Default: half the map distance between the ends.

capacity.description: bpr: people or vehicles on the link at once before it slows (+15% at capacity, 3.4x at double). linear: throughput in people per minute.

twoWay.description: false for one-direction links (one-way streets, up-only elevators, entry turnstiles).

costModel.description: bpr (roads, corridors, stairs): time = length x (1 + 0.15 x min(3, load/capacity)^4). linear (doors, turnstiles, escalators, elevators): time = length + load / capacity.

via.description: Waypoints that shape the link: from -> via... -> to. With walls, no link may touch a wall, so route it through doorways. Without an explicit length, length is half the polyline length.

share.description: Relative share of arrivals; normalized to sum to 1.

info.description: Chance an agent has live information: a wait-time app (visit) or live traffic (route).

rationality.description: Rules-policy sharpness (rules provider, outage fallback, link-by-link moves). Default 2.5 (visit) or 0.8 (route). Jev decisions do not use it.

visits.description: Visit: most places a person is served at before leaving (ER 1, food hall 2-3, theme park 4-8).

patience.description: Visit: minutes of waiting in one line this group puts up with.

likes.description: Visit: soft preference for places with these tags.

needs.description: Visit: hard filter; only places with at least one of these tags are options. Empty means every place. Must match at least one service.

origins.description: Route: origin node ids where this group's trips start. Default all origins.

destinations.description: Route: destination node ids where this group's trips end. Default all destinations.

entries.description: Visit: gate or entry node ids where this group appears. Default every gate and entry, by weight. A persona's own entry still wins about half the time.

exits.description: Visit: gate or exit node ids (or exact names) this group leaves through; a person who is done walks to the nearest of these by walking distance. Default (or []) every gate and exit. If walls leave none of them reachable, the person takes the nearest reachable gate or exit of any kind. Unknown or wrong-kind references are warnings and are ignored.

x1.description: One jamb of the doorway gap.

exterior.description: true for a door to the outside.

id.description: Unique; filled as offer1, offer2, ... when missing.

text.description: What the person is told, e.g. 'Eastgate Urgent Care: seen in 20 minutes, half the ER price'. Longer text is cut to 160 characters. When missing, an offer with a place and a discount is told '<N>% off at <place name>'; any other offer without text is dropped.

to.description: Who receives it: anyone in one of these groups or copying one of these cast members. Missing or empty means everyone. Unknown ids are warnings and are dropped; an offer whose named audience is all unknown is dropped, never sent to everyone.

cast.description: Cast member ids (or exact names) from minds.

place.description: Visit service node id (or exact name) the offer is about. Anything else is a warning and the offer is about no place. Route worlds have no service places, so their offers are messages only.

priceOff.description: Discount at place for the people who receive it: 0.5 is half price. Clamped to 0-1; ignored without a place. When several offers cover the same place, the largest discount applies (they do not stack).

from.description: Minutes after clockStart when the offer starts; at most duration.

until.description: Minutes after clockStart when it ends; between from and duration. Default duration.

name.description: Realistic invented full name; never a real person.

bio.description: Their situation right now: why they are here, what is at stake, deadlines.

personality.description: A few traits that change choices.

goal.description: What they want from this visit or trip.

social.description: Who they listen to: a spouse, a group chat, the radio, the app, the crowd, nobody.

informed.description: Whether this person has the wait-time app or live traffic. Default: archetype info >= 0.5.

entry.description: Visit: gate or entry node id this persona usually comes in through.

origin.description: Route: origin node id of this persona's trip.

destination.description: Route: destination node id of this persona's trip.
